title: Cheney and Bush as possible disclosure gatekeepers

tellings.quote: You hear Dick Cheny's name, you know, around uh you hear George W. Bush might have contemplated UFO disclosure.

plain: Dick Cheney's name comes up around the UFO question, Michels says, and George W. Bush might have considered disclosure, meaning the government openly revealing what it knows about UFOs. Michels raises this himself as talk he has heard, without naming a source. If true, it would put the decision at the top of the White House in the 2000s.
